# PlayCanvas Engine API

> The API reference of the PlayCanvas Engine, `playcanvas` {{VERSION}} on npm: its classes, interfaces, type aliases and functions by category, and its constants.

Each link leads to a Markdown page with the symbol's signatures, parameters, return values and examples, and a class's page documents its members. When `playcanvas` is installed, `node_modules/playcanvas/build/playcanvas.d.ts` has the same documentation for the installed version. For guides, see the [Engine index](https://developer.playcanvas.com/user-manual/engine/llms.txt) of the User Manual.

## Start here

- [AppBase](classes/AppBase.md): The application, and the preferred entry point for new code: create a device with [createGraphicsDevice](functions/createGraphicsDevice.md), then call `init` with [AppOptions](classes/AppOptions.md) that register only the component systems and resource handlers the app uses. [Application](classes/Application.md) registers them all, so none can be tree-shaken, and is expected to be deprecated.
- [Entity](classes/Entity.md)
- [Script](classes/Script.md)
- [Asset](classes/Asset.md)
- [AssetListLoader](classes/AssetListLoader.md)
- [CameraComponent](classes/CameraComponent.md)
- [LightComponent](classes/LightComponent.md)
- [RenderComponent](classes/RenderComponent.md)
- [StandardMaterial](classes/StandardMaterial.md)
- [GSplatComponent](classes/GSplatComponent.md)
- [RigidBodyComponent](classes/RigidBodyComponent.md)
- [Vec3](classes/Vec3.md)
- [Constants](constants.md): Every constant, grouped by prefix, with its value.
